biotools.summary: E-GuARD is a framework that addresses data scarcity in early drug discovery by combining self-distillation, active learning, and expert-guided molecular generation to improve the detection of compounds interfering with biological assays. It iteratively enriches training data and demonstrates improved performance across several data sets.
